messages:
priya: heads-up: the quickstart sample app expects an admin endpoint to list customer models, but our Python SDK doesn't expose it. curl works. blocking onboarding demo. anyone seen this?

elaine: which endpoint exactly? /v1/admin/models/list? i thought admin ops were behind a separate AdminClient but we never shipped that in py. can you paste the error?

priya: error: 
```
AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'list_models_admin'
```
curl with same token returns 200 and a list.

sam: that's rough for first-run UX. short term: document REST fallback and add a tiny requests snippet in quickstart. long term: add AdminClient surface in py and align retry/auth behavior across SDKs.

elaine: also flagging a related parity issue: node SDK auto-retries certain idempotent POSTs on 5xx/429; python does not. the demo got a transient 502, frontend retried, and python surfaced the error leading to duplicate token consumption in the app flow.

priya: oh no — was Node sending an idempotency key? we got billed twice for a demo account.

sam: Node will attach Idempotency-Key when callers set it; its auto-retry heuristics also retry safe POSTs without a key. Python currently only retries on network-level issues via requests adapter. mismatch causes different retry surfaces.

elaine: plan: i will (1) add a REST fallback snippet to the quickstart docs, (2) open a py-sdk PR to introduce AdminClient (list/get/update minimal surface) and to add configurable retry policy that avoids silent duplicates for non-idempotent ops, and (3) include an auth-scope test.

priya: can you paste the quick workaround? i'll patch CI so onboarding demo isn't blocked.

sam: workaround (python requests):
```
import os, requests
r = requests.get(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/models/list',
  headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']}"}
)
print(r.json())
```
for streaming responses: use `stream=True` and iterate `r.iter_lines()` to match REST streaming.

elaine: filing GH issue and adding a test to assert no silent retries for POSTs without explicit Idempotency-Key.

devex-bot: Created issue #543: "py-sdk: admin client + retry parity with node" and added label devex/priority-medium. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/543

priya: great — added to quickstart checklist. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
